title: [DE] Company structure
subtitle: [DE] Arrange hierarchy levels and manage the units of each level.

levels.title: [DE] Levels
levels.subtitle: [DE] Hierarchy order from top to bottom. Use "+" between two levels to insert a new one.
levels.addDescription: [DE] The new level is inserted right below "{{name}}".
levels.name: [DE] Level name
levels.deleteConfirm: [DE] The "{{name}}" level and all of its units will be deactivated. Continue?

units.name: [DE] Name
units.parentHint: [DE] Optional. Only units of higher levels can be selected.
units.locationHint: [DE] Optional. The branch's physical location (address and country live on the Locations screen).
units.empty: [DE] No units in the {{level}} level yet. Use "Add new" to create one.
units.deactivateConfirm: [DE] The "{{name}}" unit will be deactivated. Continue?

approvalPolicies.title: [DE] Onay süreçleri
approvalPolicies.hint: [DE] Opsiyonel alanlar. Boş bırakılan tür üst birimden devralınır.
approvalPolicies.defaultFirstManager: [DE] Süreç atanmadı; talepler çalışanın ilk yöneticisine gider.
approvalPolicies.workflowUnavailable: [DE] Onay süreçleri Workflow modülü devreye girdiğinde seçilebilecek.

companies.createDescription: [DE] Enter the company name and holiday calendar. The calendar applies to every unit down to the lowest level of the company.
companies.holidayCalendarHint: [DE] Public holidays come automatically from this calendar and are listed on the home page.

authorization.title: [DE] Unit authorization
authorization.subtitle: [DE] Authorized people for the "{{name}}" unit
authorization.explainScope: [DE] The authorization applies to this unit and all of its sub-units. The same person can be authorized for several units.
authorization.explainAbilities: [DE] The authorized person can list, open and update employee cards in these units and add new employees to them.
authorization.explainCustomReports: [DE] "Build your own" reports are never available to unit managers.
authorization.empty: [DE] No one is authorized for this unit yet.
authorization.canViewSalary: [DE] Can access employees' payment and salary information
authorization.canViewReports: [DE] Can access their own unit's reports
authorization.flagRequired: [DE] At least one option must be turned on.
authorization.removeConfirm: [DE] {{person}}'s authorization for the "{{unit}}" unit will be removed. Continue?

calendars.subtitle: [DE] Manage the public and company-specific holiday calendars assigned to companies.
calendars.recurringLabel: [DE] Repeat on the same day every year
calendars.createDescription: [DE] Create a calendar for your company, then add holidays and assign it to a company.
calendars.name: [DE] Calendar name

errors.generic: [DE] Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: [DE] You don't have permission for this action.
errors.levelSystemImmutable: [DE] The Company level is a system level and can't be deleted.
errors.levelInUse: [DE] This level can't be deleted because its units have active employees.
errors.unitHasChildren: [DE] This unit has active sub-units and can't be deactivated. Move or deactivate the sub-units first.
errors.parentCycle: [DE] The selected parent unit would create a cycle.
errors.locationInUse: [DE] The location is linked to an active unit.
